home.headline_1: Between the Factory Floor and the Cloud
home.subheadline: I specialise in industrial system integration, edge-to-cloud architecture, and full-stack development — connecting device data, operational workflows, and cloud services into maintainable, traceable, and long-term-evolvable software systems.

about.headline: An Engineer Working at the Intersection of Systems
about.bio_1: A senior full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience, my work spans industrial environments, digital humanities, information systems, and self-initiated projects.
about.bio_2: My core strength is integrating edge device data, monitoring workflows, AI inference, and cloud business systems into stable, maintainable, long-term-evolvable digital architectures.
about.bio_3: I continuously practise self-awareness and AI-augmented development, believing the true mark of a senior engineer is knowing which problem environments they solve best.
about.meta_description: Gary Wu — senior full-stack engineer in industrial system integration and edge-to-cloud architecture. 5+ years connecting IPC, SCADA, AI, and cloud into maintainable, evolvable systems.

lab.headline: Experiments & Self-Initiated Work
lab.intro: A collection of side projects I started myself — from POCs and creative ideas integrating technology, to apps that showcase technical capability. Often without a client, driven by curiosity and a spirit of experimentation.
